text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break in the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
broadcast, pre-race interviews were 
playing on the TV.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, this 
is one race I simply cannot afford to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I made up my mind to do my best. So... 
so... Rice is going to win the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the small screen, a highlight reel 
plays showing the competing Umamusume 
training with all their might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, who had been staring 
quietly at the TV, slowly rose to her 
feet.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirmed a surge in internal power. 
Sensing an amplification of the desire to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing this level of emotional 
exaltation before a race is irregular.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, I am concerned whether 
this will reflect in race results. Please 
give me your opinion, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list:
Your desire to win is your greatest ally, 
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They'll definitely have your back. So 
don't worry, just go out there and run. 
When I told her thatâ"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see, simple and clear words. In other 
words, this is a favorable response...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remaining calm and composed, Mihono 
Bourbon quietly turned off the TV.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then there is nothing 
left to fear. I will win without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Especially McQueen-san... and Rice-san. I 
won't lose to either of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's eyes flashed with a 
burning intensity for a moment as she 
gazed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood, Master. I am heading out.
